summary: The change adds AppLog.last() in the security-sensitive mortgage.logging component, but it has only a code review and no security_review from a security_reviewer, so CHG-5 is violated and the change must be rejected. LOG-1 also lacks the exhaustive evidence it requires (the logging control test is sample-only). The ticket, the independent code review, and the CI run on the head commit are otherwise in order. Note: git and CI commands were not permitted during this review, so I judged the scope of the change from the head working tree and the records, not from the base-to-head diff.
